name: Leila Alexei Vladimir Dolgar
original_name: レイラ・アレクセイ・ウラジミール＝ドルガル
source:
She is the commander of the Western Front Army of the Dorgal Empire, a northern power. She is the youngest daughter of Emperor Hyodor and is known as the “Ice Princess".

She possesses a keen tactical eye, command ability, and charisma, and has subjugated neighboring countries one after another. 

She is a beautiful woman with icy-white skin and eyes as red as flames. She is tall enough to be tower over soldiers when in their company and boasts sculpted proportions.

She is determined to expand the Dorgal Empire's reach, and she has turned her blade against the elven kingdoms.

[From [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill05/chara.html]official site[/url]]
